findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: connect_account, app_store_funnel, campaigns, to_do, app_store_reviews · Private data: connect_account, meta_diagnose, attribution_setup, campaigns, verify_domain, list_domains, ai_referrals_setup · Public sink: app_performance, briefing, campaigns, ai_referrals_setup · Destructive: app_map_sources, briefing, site_guides, mark_move, organic_todo, app_store_keywords, close_site_guide, launch_ai_answers, ai_visibility_run_now, ai_visibility_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: connect_account, app_store_funnel, campaigns, to_do, app_store_reviews · Private data: connect_account, meta_diagnose, attribution_setup, campaigns, verify_domain, list_domains, ai_referrals_setup · Public sink: app_performance, briefing, campaigns, ai_referrals_setup · Destructive: app_map_sources, briefing, site_guides, mark_move, organic_todo, app_store_keywords, close_site_guide, launch_ai_answers, ai_visibility_run_now, ai_visibility_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
